column1: # K322 S5 (K320 (5), K321 (g)): the Desk, its crisis plate and game over, the top strip's held line, the Docket, Statistics, People, the signing plate's title, the Docket's Fed items and the saves menu - every string the sweep took off the page at rest, and the frame whose slip book (two levels) or draws now hold it.

# capture_stem: the frame that drew it. text_before: the draw as the label table wrote it (figures folded to '#'). now_in: slip:<stem> (that frame's slip book) or dense:<stem> (that frame's draws). slip_text: the words that hold it, figures as '#'. countries: empty where every film that takes the frame holds it, else the films' countries.
# K334: the convertible prose rows of moved_s10si.tsv (S10's debt-line label) and moved_s6fe.tsv (S6's abroad frames whose state a capture reaches) are converted below, at the foot.

# RETIRED, not converted (K334): moved_s5pc.tsv's rows sit on 01k1_create_profile, 01k3_create_declarations and 01k5_create_review, which Tools/declutter_rules.tsv exempts from every cap (01k?_create_*, setup) - DeclutterReachabilityCheck refuses a moved row on an exempt frame, since nothing on it is decluttered. Their record, verbatim: GRASSROOTS MOVEMENT (and the five other origin titles in capitals) -> at rest the origin glyph and the title in the board's case; each valkrets name as a chip under REGION -> region/tile/<id> on the constituency map, the picked one at rest beside its tile (slip: the valkrets's name / Your constituency | Press to stand here); OUTSIDE THE CABINET -> at rest OUTSIDE SUPPORT; DECLARATIONS (one row of marks and glyphs) -> at rest RED LINES · CANDIDACY · OUTSIDE SUPPORT over their glyphs.

# NOT A MACHINE ROW (the judge has no film-kind scope): 89f_signing_budget_contest's Canvas title "Annual budget: the government's frames adopted, # to #, over S's alternative" now reads "Annual budget" at rest; its tail is the division column's at rest on the same frame (The government's frames · ADOPTED · S's alternative) and the title's Canvas slip. A dry film takes 89f without its Canvas text, so a dense:89f row would read UNREACHABLE there.
